about: Messages the panel writes into a session on the person's behalf. Each sample is the input of its writer, the exact text the writer makes of it and what the feed reads back from that text. The Go tests of the writers rebuild the text from the input; the fixture panelsaid.html reads the text with the parser of the feed. Bubbles are texts that must stay messages of the person.
